inline_text:
## What
Adds `goose` to the landscape under Autonomous Agent Frameworks. goose was donated to the AAIF at launch alongside MCP but is not on the map yet. Closes #25.

## Notes
- Metadata matches the published aaif-landscape entry: `goose-docs.ai` and `github.com/aaif-goose/goose` (the AAIF-org home the project moved to after donation, rather than the original `block/goose`). Thanks @asish-singh for proposing the entry in #25.
- Set `project: member` to match MCP, the other launch-donated hosted project, which is `member` here today. If editors would rather classify launch-hosted projects as `graduated` or `incubating`, happy to change goose and MCP together.
- Two other AAIF hosted projects are also absent from this landscape, `agentgateway` and `AGENTS.md`, but neither has an obvious existing subcategory (a gateway/control-plane and a file-format convention), so I left their placement to the Domain Editors rather than invent one. Happy to follow up.

## Validation
`landscape.yml` parses and the entry conforms to `docs/data-schemas.md` (required `name`, `homepage_url`, `description`, `project`; optional `repo_url`).
